verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing platform, so user-configurable background automations are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack shows no feature that lets a user define autonomous background automations. The closest items are adjacent: a 3DS risk rule, stand-in authorization, merchant blocking and webhook notifications are fixed platform behaviors or event callbacks, and the MCP server only searches endpoints and generates code examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
